status: post-freeze EXPLORATORY development cross-validation on the reused v3 inner folds; ADAPTIVE (child rows prioritised after the H_RT result); nothing here is blind, independent or confirmatory
unchanged: protocol_v4.json, amendment_1.json, amendment_2.json and every earlier declaration
all v1-v3 evidence; Stage H, Stage I, Stage J Phase 1 and Phase 2, H_RT results and receipts
J1-J3 gates, metric definitions, gamma grid, candidate universe, thresholds and tie rules
scope: replaces, prospectively and for J4a-J7 evaluation only, the use of amendment_2.nested_parent_rule as the child gate; the registered J4a-J7 row definitions and the parent J2 are unchanged

parent.selection: best of J1-J3 by seed-0 screen H_bal (stage_j_v4 order / amendment 2), fixed before any child experiment; J2 was chosen after examining all six development folds, so the comparator is not independent of held-fold outcomes

child.augmentation: ColorJitter(0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.05) + RandomGrayscale(0.1) + GaussianBlur(kernel 9, sigma 0.1-2.0, p 0.2) on the CLIP-resized centre crop, + h-flip (the parent's flip is kept)
child.training: jrun.run_fold unchanged: declared 5 epochs, AdamW lr 1e-5 / 1e-3, wd 0.05, cosine with 1 warm-up epoch, AMP, batch 32, composition-balanced sampler, seed-derived initialisation from the original pretrained weights (torch seed 1000*seed + fold index)
child.folds: the six registered inner folds I1-I6 (benchmark v3), ordered as registered

primary_gate.comparison: child vs J2 on every fold (same parent for every fold)
primary_gate.calibration: each row's own LOFO choice (config, gamma) on the other five folds by mean H_bal; ties -> lower config, smaller gamma
primary_gate.per_fold: d_s(k) = H_bal child - H_bal J2; AUSUC and healthy-shortcut differences likewise; means over seeds
primary_gate.decision_function: child_gate.promotion_decision(child tables, parent tables, mode): recomputed from verified tables only
primary_gate.null_child: a child identical to J2 fails (0 pp, 0/6)
primary_gate.decision_meaning: screen pass -> seeds 1-2 may be considered only after independent review; confirmation pass -> 'confirmed vs J2' (exploratory); never promotion above D1 without separate review

diagnostics_no_pass_fail: source-stratified seen Top-1 (dominant / other fitting source / novel)
verification: child_inputs.verified_pair (production): registered J2 runs and the authorised child only, no overrides
receipts via confirm.verified_row_seed (single attempt, file hashes, declared config, torch seed, gradient/AMP/frozen/reload checks, code identity, clean worktree)
registered fold, receipt contract = fold_contract(registered fold), feature-cache row set, no fitting/eval lineage overlap
ordered evaluation image identity; child_identity.json sidecar for every child attempt
mandatory packet re-derivation from the feature cache in registered order, |diff| <= 1e-05
exactly one registered modification vs J2; same training-code hash; distinct child and parent checkpoints
sealed tables (HMAC over identity and score arrays); unsealed or non-re-derived tables are refused by the gate
child_run: declaration verified, (row, seed) authorised, clean worktree, protected evidence directories, new attempt dirs, failures and rejections kept
J2 parent preflight (re-derivation) per seed before any child scoring with that seed
uncertainty: bootstrap CIs are exploratory; bootstrap_sign_proportion_le_0 is descriptive, not a p-value, never multiplicity-adjusted; an optional cluster-randomisation test is proposed in the v3 proposal and is not part of this declaration
disclosures: reused development folds (informed v1-v3, Stage I, J1-J3)
adaptive selection of J4b after H_RT
calibration dependence (LOFO gamma ~8; H_bal at gamma 0 is 5-9%)
fixed parent J2 selected on all six folds; primary gate is an exploratory paired comparison, not nested
image-fold counts are not independent observations (e.g. other-source seen: 628 image-folds = 111 unique images)
stop: after the J4b seed-0 evaluation, regardless of outcome; report and wait for independent review
